disposition_reason: Market geophagic clay concentrations are printed for Fe, Mn and Zn by market (Table 1) and as text summaries for Cd, Pb, As, Cu, Ni and Mn; most per-market results are figure-only.

study.design: market survey of geophagic clay with pseudototal and EDTA-available PTEs, NIR spectroscopy models and ingestion/dermal health risk assessment
study.origin: clay mined and processed in the Volta Region per the introduction; origin of individual samples not stated
study.market: 8 markets in the Kumasi Metropolis, Ghana (Abuakwa, Asafo, Bantama, Central, Edwenease, Krofrom, Kwadaso, Tanoso)
study.method: Aqua regia digestion and AAS (Agilent 200) for pseudototal Fe, Cu, Zn, Mn, As, Hg, Pb, Cd; EDTA/TEA extraction for available fraction; NIRS-PLSR models
study.lod_text: AAS LOD (methods text): Pb 0.01, As 0.003, Cd 0.002, Cu 0.003, Zn 0.001 mg/kg; also listed in µg/L: Cd 0.25, Fe 0.033, Mn 0.53, Ni 1.47, Pb 8.30, Zn 0.77
study.qa: Triplicates, blanks, BAM reference materials BRM No. 13 and 10a; recoveries Pb 85-112%, As 88-115%, Cd 110-119%, Cu 89-97%, Zn 85-115%
